# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_ALIGNMENT_BOS_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon achieves bullish alignment (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55) and price simultaneously breaks above the prior swing high (BOS) on above-average volume, momentum continuation is probable. This setup captures intrinsic trend strength by requiring both structural ribbon confirmation and fresh swing-high breakout, avoiding lagging pullback entries.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 AND price closes above the most recent swing high (HH) AND volume > 1.5 * 20-period average volume → enter long at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop = max(prior swing low (LL), 1×ATR). Target = 2×risk (risk = entry - stop). If price reaches 1×risk (halfway to target), move stop to break-even. Thereafter, trail stop at 0.5×ATR.  
**Regime filters:** Only active when VIX < 20 and time between 09:45-12:00 ET; disabled if ribbon width (EMA8-EMA55) < 0.1% of price (choppy market).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would trade ~14% of headline P&L (2 contracts vs 28).
2. **Sample bias:** Zero historical backtest conducted; proposal based solely on price-action theory. High overfit risk due to untested parameters (volume multiplier, ATR trails, regime thresholds).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no validation against actual OPRA fills or slippage model).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw in low-VIX chop (ribbon width <0.1% triggers false BOS); max drawdown: consecutive stopped-out entries during range-bound markets; blow-up scenario: volatility expansion triggering multiple false BOS stops during news events.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (cannot estimate top-5 days contribution without historical simulation).
